observes: Self-test of the capacity/key/FK oracles: eval_keys clean state 0 violations and 7 seeded states each reported with exactly its code (K1 duplicate node row, duplicate edge key, duplicate prop key; K2 row without out leaf, in leaf without row, label index without row; K3 repeated edge id); eval_fk clean 0 and 9 seeds each exactly its code (F1 edge to missing node, F2 label, F3 prop of node missing in its graph, F4 embedding, F5 adjacency endpoint and label index, F6 temporal edge, F7 reification of missing edge and missing reifier node); classify gives all 7 value outcomes on synthetic triples; counter filter keeps row nodes out; live on AUDITD: kg_leaves reads 2 seeded ^IVGAuditDKeys leaves exactly (scratch killed after), scan_from uses '%IGNOREINDEX * <table>', a product-written graph (3 nodes, 1 edge) gives 0 key and 0 FK violations
